job.title: Recruitment Manager
job.description:

• Foster a collaborative, high-energy culture where success is recognised and celebrated
• Contribute strategically to the long-term growth and direction of Stellar’s Brisbane office

What We’re Looking For:
• Proven experience in agency recruitment, ideally within Engineering or Construction sectors
• Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and inspire recruitment teams
• Strong background in business development and client relationship management
• Commercially minded, proactive, and motivated to deliver results
• Someone who thrives in a growing, ambitious business and wants to help shape its future

Why You’ll Love Working at Stellar:

• Established client base with significant growth potential across Engineering & Construction
• Competitive salary + uncapped commission + evolving benefits program+ Relocation Assistance
• Career progression pathways with ongoing training and development
• Relocation opportunity to sunny Queensland and the lifestyle that comes with it

Stellar Recruitment currently operate in Australia and New Zealand. Our global team of recruitment specialists are passionate about the fields we work in so candidates and clients can be sure they are dealing with industry experts who understands their needs.

Assignments can vary in length from ad hoc requests, short or long term, full time or part-time - depending on the requirements of the Client. At times there can be the opportunity for a Temporary role to successfully become a Permanent offer.

job.title: Civil Operations Manager
job.description:
Civil Operations Manager
Wellington based | Lower North Island travel | Civil Infrastructure
 
An established civil contractor is looking for an experienced Civil Operations Manager to take ownership of project delivery, team performance and regional operations across the lower North Island.
 
Based primarily in Wellington, this role will also involve regular travel into the Manawatū and wider lower North Island to support active projects, teams and client relationships.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone currently working as a Senior Project Manager, Civil Project Manager, Construction Manager or Operations Manager who is ready to step into a broader leadership role while still staying close to the work.
 
The Opportunity
 
You'll play a key role in overseeing civil projects across the region, supporting delivery teams and making sure resources, programmes and commercial outcomes are being managed effectively.
 
You'll be involved across:
  • Regional project delivery and operational performance
  • Project programmes, budgets and cost control
  • Commercial management, variations and progress claims
  • Contract administration and project documentation
  • Labour, plant, equipment and resource planning
  • Leadership and support of Project Managers, Site Managers and Supervisors
  • Subcontractor and supplier management
  • Client, consultant and council relationships
  • Project risk, productivity and performance
  • Health and safety, quality and environmental requirements
  • Workforce planning and team development
  • Tender opportunities and regional business growth
  • Continuous improvement across project and branch operations
About You
 
We're looking for someone who understands civil construction from both an operational and commercial perspective.
 
You'll ideally bring:
  • Strong experience within civil construction or infrastructure
  • Experience leading multiple projects or operational teams
  • A background as a Civil Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager or similar
  • Strong project planning, budgeting and cost management skills
  • Experience with contract administration and variations
  • Familiarity with New Zealand construction contracts, including NZS 3910
  • Experience managing subcontractors, suppliers and site teams
  • Strong stakeholder and client management skills
  • Confidence making decisions and managing competing priorities
  • A practical, proactive and commercially minded approach
  • A full New Zealand driver licence
Experience across areas such as roading, drainage, water infrastructure, wastewater, earthworks, concrete or general civil works would be highly relevant.
 
Location & Travel
 
The role is primarily based in Wellington, with regular travel to projects throughout the Manawatū and wider lower North Island.
 
You'll need to be comfortable getting out to site, spending time with project teams and travelling where required to support regional delivery.
 
Applicants must already have the legal right to work in New Zealand.
 
Interested?
 
If this sounds like the kind of step you've been looking for, apply with your CV or get in touch with Cathy Pearson at Stellar Recruitment for a confidential chat on 027 297 9350 or catherine.p@stellarrecruitment.co.nz.

job.title: Operations Manager- Co-Living
job.description:
This is a rare opportunity to build an accommodation business from the ground up.

Imagine joining a highly successful, privately owned property group at the beginning of an exciting new chapter.

Backed by an accomplished entrepreneur with a proven track record of building successful businesses, this venture will establish a new co-living offering, commencing with a 300-bed development in Melbourne.

With an ambitious expansion strategy already taking shape across Australia's eastern seaboard, this is an opportunity to do considerably more than manage a property.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the founder, you will take ownership of the journey from concept through to a fully operational accommodation business.

Joining during the formative stages, you will influence how the asset is designed, fitted out, marketed and operated, ensuring every decision contributes to an exceptional resident experience and commercially successful business.

  • Working alongside the development team to influence design, fit-out, functionality and operational readiness.
  • Developing the operating model, systems, processes and technology required to launch and manage the facility.
  • Establishing the commercial strategy, including pricing, leasing, marketing and resident acquisition.
  • Building, leading and developing the team responsible for delivering an exceptional resident experience.
  • Overseeing pre-opening preparations, commissioning, mobilisation and the transition into operations.
  • Driving occupancy, revenue, operating performance and resident satisfaction.
  • Creating a scalable operating blueprint to support future developments across the eastern seaboard.
About You

You will bring proven leadership experience from the student accommodation, purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) or co-living sector.

Importantly, you will have previously played a leading role in taking a new accommodation development from concept or pre-opening through to a successful operating business.

Why This Opportunity?

Few roles offer the chance to influence a business so comprehensively from its inception.

You will work directly with a highly experienced and successful entrepreneur who is committed to the venture and prepared to provide the right person with genuine autonomy.

There is an established development opportunity, an ambitious growth strategy and the backing to turn that strategy into reality.

Your influence will extend well beyond the first building. You will help define what this business becomes.

An attractive executive remuneration package and performance incentives will be negotiated commensurate with experience.

To apply do so via SEEK with your CV and a brief outline of your experience launching and operating new accommodation developments.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Shaun McCambridge on 0421 860 064.

This is not a traditional coordination-focused Project Manager position. You will be expected to understand what is happening on site, challenge programme and contractor performance, identify risks early and ensure the client has clear visibility across delivery.

The Role

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Monitoring MEP, services and commissioning activities
  • Ensuring works are inspection and milestone ready
  • Providing clear reporting around programme, risk, actions and recovery strategies
  • Maintaining strong relationships across client, developer, contractor and consultant teams
About You
This position requires someone with genuine construction delivery experience who is comfortable operating at a senior level within a complex, fast-moving project environment.
 
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Approximately 10-15+ years' project/construction delivery experience
  • Strong data centre or mission-critical project experience
  • Head Contractor / General Contractor background highly regarded
  • Strong understanding of construction methodology and site delivery
  • Experience across MEP, building services and commissioning
  • Strong programme and critical path management capability
  • Experience identifying and implementing programme recovery strategies
  • Ability to challenge senior contractors and developers constructively
  • Strong commercial and risk awareness
  • Confidence operating as a senior client representative
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Construction Management, Engineering or similar
Candidates from a consultancy background will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong technical and mission-critical project delivery experience.
 
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional project coordination and represent the client on one of Queensland's significant emerging data centre developments. You'll be joining a globally recognised consultancy with an established data centre capability and exposure to major projects across Australia and internationally.

Site Safety Supervisor
Auckland - Fixed-Term Contract
  
Are you an experienced Health & Safety professional who enjoys being in the field, working alongside crews and ensuring critical controls are effective where they matter most?
  
We are seeking a hands-on Site Safety Supervisor to support a major project within an operating fuel terminal. This site-based role focuses on safety leadership, critical risk verification, permit compliance and helping construction teams deliver work safely and efficiently.
  
About the Role
Reporting to the Project Manager, you will be responsible for providing day-to-day safety assurance across multiple work fronts, ensuring activities are undertaken in accordance with approved safety plans, permits, procedures and critical risk controls.
  
Key activities will include:
  • Conduct site inspections, audits and verify critical safety controls across active work fronts.
  • Monitor permits, isolations, confined space activities and high-risk work compliance.
  • Oversee lifting operations, scaffolding, work at height and hot work activities.
  • Participate in pre-starts, work planning and provide practical safety guidance to site teams.
  • Investigate incidents and near misses while managing corrective actions and safety reporting.
  • Coordinate with contractors and stakeholders to ensure safe project delivery and emergency readiness.
  
About You
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
  • NZ Level 4 Health & Safety qualification (or equivalent) with 5+ years' site-based HSE experience.
  • Strong background in high-risk industrial, construction, shutdown or maintenance environments.
  • Proven knowledge of permits, confined spaces, isolations, lifting, work at height and hot work.
  • Current First Aid certification and experience investigating incidents and corrective actions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across multiple contractors and workgroups.
  • Confident promoting safe work practices and influencing positive safety behaviours on site.
  
Highly Regarded
  • Diploma-level H&S qualifications, NEBOSH, IOSH or similar
  • ICAM or equivalent investigation training
  • Experience working around tank infrastructure, fuel terminals, refineries, energy facilities or other high-hazard sites
  • Knowledge of occupational hygiene and exposure monitoring programmes
  
What's on Offer?
  • Major industrial project with an immediate start available.
  • High-autonomy role with ownership of site safety outcomes.
  • Work alongside an experienced and collaborative project team.
  • Competitive remuneration package on offer.
  • Fixed-term contract running through to March 2027.
  
If you're a proactive safety professional who enjoys being on site, building relationships with crews and ensuring work is completed safely and efficiently, we'd love to hear from you.

You’ll need to be equally comfortable shaping strategy with the CEO, building a boardroom case for investment, meeting industry partners and spending time on-site understanding the people and communities TIACS exists to support.

job.title: Superintendent - Metallurgy
job.description:
• Lead metallurgy, process control and laboratory performance at a major zinc-lead operation
  • Senior leadership role with Glencore’s McArthur River Mine
  • Attractive FIFO roster, competitive remuneration and long-term career opportunities
Stellar Recruitment is partnering with Glencore to appoint a Superintendent – Metallurgy at McArthur River Mine in the Northern Territory.
Located approximately 970 kilometres south-east of Darwin, McArthur River Mine is one of Australia’s largest zinc-lead operations. The site incorporates an open-cut mine, processing facilities and a logistics network transporting concentrate to the Bing Bong Loading Facility for export to customers around the world.

This is an opportunity to take a senior leadership role within a technically complex processing operation and influence plant performance, recovery, product quality and continuous improvement.

The role:

Reporting to the Manager – Metallurgy and Port Operations, the Superintendent – Metallurgy will lead the site’s metallurgical, process-control and laboratory functions.

You will be accountable for ensuring metallurgical systems operate safely and effectively while delivering planned production volumes and product-quality outcomes. The position will provide technical leadership to the metallurgy and laboratory teams and work closely with processing, maintenance, technical and HSE stakeholders.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Monitor and optimise plant metallurgical performance and process-control systems.
  • Identify performance constraints and coordinate practical remedial actions.
  • Lead the implementation of new process systems, equipment and plant upgrades.
  • Drive improvements in recovery, throughput, stability and concentrate quality.
  • Ensure the metallurgical laboratory operates safely, efficiently and in accordance with required standards.
  • Provide technical direction, coaching and development to metallurgical and laboratory personnel.
  • Lead, mentor and manage a multidisciplinary metallurgy and laboratory team.
  • Contribute to annual business plans, operating budgets, capital budgets and performance reporting.
  • Manage the availability, consumption and cost-effective use of major plant consumables.
  • Support plant trials, technical investigations and improvement projects.
  • Work collaboratively with production, maintenance and HSE teams to deliver safe and sustainable operational outcomes.
About You:

To succeed in this position, you will bring:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Metallurgical, Chemical or Process Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Substantial practical experience within mineral-processing or metallurgical plant operations.
  • Strong knowledge of metallurgical processes, plant optimisation and process-control systems.
  • Experience in complex base-metal concentrators or flotation operations will be highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing metallurgists, laboratory personnel or processing technical teams.
  • A sound understanding of metallurgical laboratory practices, sampling, analysis and quality control.
  • Experience delivering process-improvement initiatives, plant trials, equipment upgrades or operational projects.
  • Exposure to operating budgets, capital planning, cost control and technical performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making capability.
  • The ability to translate technical findings into clear operational actions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across operational and technical functions.
Benefits:
  • Permanent senior leadership opportunity with Glencore.
  • Attractive FIFO 9 days on 5 days off roster from any capital city
  • Competitive remuneration package and applicable site benefits.
  • Support from an experienced site leadership and technical-services team.
  • Long-term professional development opportunities across Glencore’s Australian and international operations.
  • Work within a large-scale operation offering complex technical challenges and significant scope for improvement.
To Apply:

This recruitment process is being managed by Lucas Eyers at Stellar Recruitment. Please apply via SEEK or LinkedIn or contact Lucas directly to discuss in confidence.

+61 4 5248 3407 or email lucas@stellarrecruitment.com.au

job.title: National Engagement Lead
job.description:
About TIACS

We are all about showing up where it matters — on worksites, in communities, and alongside the people and industries we’re in it with.

We are building one of the most innovative social purpose counselling services in the country and are looking for an experienced National Engagement Lead to join the team.

TIACS is Australia’s home of blue-collar counselling, providing free, confidential and accessible professional support to tradies, truckies, farmers, apprentices, blue-collar workers and the people who care about them.

No waitlists. No referrals. No cost.

This role is about making sure the people who need that support know TIACS exists, trust the service, and know how to access it.

TIACS - The Home of Blue Collar Counselling By Industry for Industry

The role

This is not a desk-based role.

Based in Brisbane, you’ll work nationally across worksites, industry events and community initiatives, building trusted relationships with workers, employers, industry groups and decision-makers.

You’ll lead TIACS’ engagement activity across priority industries and regions, while connecting on-the-ground insights with the broader partnerships strategy to identify opportunities and create longer-term impact.

The role includes regular interstate and regional travel, early starts, evening events and occasional weekend work.

If you enjoy being out with people and building relationships face-to-face, this could be a great fit.

What you’ll be doing
  • Building trusted relationships with workers, employers, supervisors and industry leaders
  • Representing TIACS across worksites, industry events and community activities
  • Delivering practical, relatable engagement that makes mental health support easier to understand and access
  • Building repeat engagement across priority industries and regions
  • Identifying partnership, alliance and fundraising opportunities from conversations in the field
  • Working closely with the Head of Partnerships & Impact to progress opportunities
  • Coordinating national engagement activity, bookings and travel
  • Capturing engagement activity, contacts and insights in HubSpot
  • Sharing on-the-ground themes, barriers and opportunities with the wider TIACS team
  • Supporting and guiding the Industry & Community Engagement Officer where required
Who we’re looking for

You do not need to be a counsellor. This is a non-clinical role.

We’re looking for someone grounded, credible and genuinely good with people.
You might come from a community engagement, partnerships, fundraising or field-based background.

More importantly, you’ll be someone who can walk onto a worksite and connect naturally with the crew, then sit down with senior leaders and hold your own.

You’ll need to be able to:
  • Build trust without relying on a polished sales pitch
  • Communicate naturally with different audiences
  • Handle sensitive conversations with good judgement and clear boundaries
  • Work independently and stay organised across a national travel schedule
  • Follow through on conversations and relationships h
  • Represent TIACS in a way that is authentic, approachable and down to earth
How to apply:

Apply via SEEK for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Parts Correspondent
job.description:
The role:
If you're organised, customer-focused, and passionate about parts, this is a great opportunity to join TDX as a Parts Correspondent. You'll play an important role in managing customer enquiries, processing orders, providing product information, and ensuring parts solutions are delivered efficiently and accurately.

Reporting to the Parts Manager, you will be responsible for interpreting customer enquiries, processing orders accurately, coordinating parts availability, and supporting internal teams to ensure customers receive the highest level of service.

 Responsibilities include:
  • Provide face-to-face, over the phone and email support and advice to our customers to ensure they receive the right part, at the right price, at the right time and place.
  • Interpret & process incoming purchase orders for efficient dispatch
  • Coordinate the dispatch of customer orders within an acceptable time frame, ensuring all documentation requirements are met
  • Quote enquiries, monitor sales orders daily
  • Be committed to providing a quality service to internal and external customers and suppliers
Who are we?
TDX is a true New Zealand success story and 100% New Zealand owned and operated. From humble beginnings when we were set up over 40 years ago by a couple of mates, today TDX is recognised as the market leader for sales and service of construction equipment. We service our highly valued customers in the civil, forestry, construction, mining and marine sectors across all of New Zealand.

TDX is the distributor of leading global brands including Volvo CE, Yanmar CE, Shell Lubricants, Fuchs Kohler Generators, Perkins Engines and Allison Transmissions. We are committed to combining world-class experience with local know-how.

What’s in it for you?
  • Supportive and friendly team environment
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Weekly pay
  • company bonus
  • On-site parking
  • Discounts on retail products
  • Life insurance
  • Discounted medical insurance
  • Opportunities to grow your career with a market-leading New Zealand-owned business
At TDX, we are passionate about supporting our people and creating a workplace where everyone can succeed. You’ll be part of a team that works together, values each other’s contribution, and is committed to delivering the best possible customer experience every time.

You will ideally have:
  • Previous experience in a parts department or similar customer-focused role
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Confidence using computer systems, including Microsoft Office
  • A positive and enthusiastic attitude with a willingness to learn
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with a leading New Zealand-owned business and bring your passion for parts and customer service, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the TDX team.

job.title: Maintenance Officer (Workshop Parts)
job.description:
Maintenance Officer (Workshop Parts)
 
Glencore Mount Isa Mines | Mount Isa, QLD | 7 Days On / 7 Days Off (Days Only)
 
Our client, Glencore Mount Isa Mines, is seeking an experienced Maintenance Officer to join their Mobile Maintenance team, supporting the ISF & Rebuild Workshop. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of one of Australia's leading mining operations, playing a vital role in ensuring maintenance activities are supported through the efficient coordination and management of parts and materials.

Working closely with planners, supervisors, leading hands and tradespeople, you'll help keep maintenance schedules on track by ensuring the right parts are available at the right time, while maintaining strong communication across the maintenance and supply teams.
 
About the Role:

You will be responsible for coordinating workshop parts and consumables, supporting maintenance planning activities, and ensuring workshop operations run efficiently.
 
What's on Offer:
  • Join Glencore Mount Isa Mines, one of Australia's premier mining operations.
  • Lifestyle roster of 7 days on / 7 days off (day shift only).
  • Work within a highly experienced Mobile Maintenance team supporting a large surface mining fleet.
  • Ongoing career development and training opportunities.
  • Competitive remuneration and the opportunity to build your career with a respected global mining company.
Your responsibilities:
  • Coordinating the dispatch and receipt of maintenance parts to support workshop rebuild and maintenance activities.
  • Working closely with maintenance planners, supervisors and warehouse personnel to ensure parts are available for scheduled work.
  • Monitoring parts availability and proactively communicating any supply risks or delays.
  • Ordering parts, tracking deliveries and following up outstanding purchase requests.
  • Receiving, inspecting and organizing incoming parts within designated staging areas.
  • Coordinating the collection and delivery of parts and components across the operation.
  • Maintaining workshop consumable stock levels.
  • Managing excess inventory registers and identifying opportunities to reduce surplus stock.
  • Processing catalogue additions and maintaining accurate parts information within SAP.
  • Supporting continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workshop efficiency and reduce waste.
  • Completing general administrative tasks and maintaining accurate maintenance records.
  • Promoting a safe, collaborative and customer-focused working environment in line with Glencore's values.
About You:
  • Previous experience in a maintenance support, workshop administration, stores or parts coordination role within mining or heavy industry.
  • Exposure to mobile mining equipment, heavy earthmoving equipment or heavy vehicle maintenance.
  • Willing to relocate to Mount Isa 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and within a collaborative maintenance team.
  • Experience using SAP or a similar Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is highly regarded.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills.
  • A current manual driver's licence.
  • A current forklift licence, or the willingness to obtain one.

job.title: Supervisor - Surface Fleet Operations
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Stellar Recruitment is proud to partner with Glencore Mount Isa Mines to recruit a Supervisor - Isa Surface Fleet within the Isa Surface Operations Department.

Reporting to the Isa Surface Fleet Superintendent, you’ll oversee the people and mobile equipment responsible for bulk materials handling across site. The fleet includes dump trucks, Kress haulers, loaders, graders, watercarts and dozers, supporting the requirements of multiple operating departments.

This is an operations and production leadership role, suited to someone who has progressed from operating heavy mobile equipment into supervising a crew. You’ll balance production priorities, safe equipment movements and team performance, while working closely with maintenance to coordinate equipment availability.

The operating environment includes established infrastructure and confined work areas, so practical equipment knowledge, sound judgement and clear communication are essential.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage a crew of up to 15 setting clear expectations around safety and production.
  • Plan and coordinate operators and equipment to meet shift priorities and material movement requirements.
  • Oversee bulk materials handling activities, including stockpile movements, wagon loading and slag handling.
  • Maintain safe operating standards around mobile equipment, infrastructure and other site users.
  • Coordinate equipment servicing and maintenance requirements with workshop supervisors.
  • Manage day-to-day personnel matters, crew performance and communication.
  • Liaise with other operating departments and contractors to support production and safe road and rail deliveries.
  • Complete shift paperwork, reporting and operational data capture.
About You
  • Strong hands-on operating experience with haul trucks and loaders.
  • Proven experience leading an operational crew, ideally having progressed from an operator background.
  • A practical understanding of mobile equipment operations, safe material movements and production requirements.
  • Confidence managing people, setting expectations and handling day-to-day personnel issues.
  • Computer literacy and the ability to maintain accurate records and reports.
  • Strong communication, time management and problem-solving skills.
  • A commitment to safe production and the ability to adapt to changing operational priorities.
What’s on Offer?
  • Residential Mount Isa position, allowing you to return home after each shift.
  • A 4-on, 4-off rotating day and night roster.
  • Responsibility for an operational crew and a diverse surface fleet.
  • A varied role combining production coordination, people leadership and collaboration across site.
Please note: Candidates must reside in Mount Isa or be willing to relocate.

If you’re an experienced operational supervisor with a strong mobile equipment background, we’d love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact Rob Gantly at Stellar Recruitment, or click Apply Now.

job.description:
About the role

Stellar Recruitment is partnering with a growing Australian business within the specialist building services sector to recruit a Sales Support Coordinator for their NSW team in Rosebery.

You'll sit at the centre of the sales and customer journey, managing incoming enquiries, supporting the sales team and helping ensure projects continue moving from initial enquiry through to production and handover.

It’s also a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and looking for exposure to sales, with the chance to build an understanding of the sales process while working closely with customers and an experienced sales team.

The role will suit someone who enjoys taking ownership, keeping on top of the detail and being the person others can rely on to make sure things get done.

Business Support Administrator | Manufacturing
Lower Hutt | Permanent | Full-Time | Monday to Friday
  
If you’re organised, practical and enjoy working in a busy environment where there’s always something happening, this could be a great fit.
  
Our client is an established Lower Hutt-based business operating in a hands-on engineering environment. Their administration team plays a key role in keeping the wider business running smoothly, and they’re looking for someone reliable who can come in, pick things up quickly and become a trusted part of the team.
  
This is a varied business support role with a strong accounts focus, alongside purchasing, timesheet administration and general office support. It would suit someone who enjoys being across different areas of a business and is comfortable working at pace.

Experience using an ERP system is also important. We’re open on the specific platform, as long as you’re comfortable learning systems, following processes and working through something that may not always be particularly user-friendly.
  
Payroll experience is useful but doesn’t need to be extensive. The payroll side of the role is primarily focused on checking and collating timesheets before they are sent through to an external provider.

job.title: Senior Production Engineer
job.description:
Lead Production. Develop People. Drive Performance.
 
We're seeking an experienced Senior Production Engineer to join a high-performing underground gold operation and play a key leadership role in delivering safe, efficient and profitable production outcomes.
 
This opportunity offers the perfect blend of technical engineering and people leadership. You'll lead a team of Mining Engineers, oversee drill & blast activities, optimise production performance, and work closely with site leadership to achieve operational targets.
 
If you're looking to take the next step in your leadership career while remaining heavily involved in the technical aspects of underground mining, this is a role worth exploring.
 
Why Apply?
  • 8/6 FIFO roster (Tuesday to Tuesday)
  • DIDO option available
  • Permanent, long-term opportunity
  • Leadership role with direct influence on site performance
  • Strong mix of technical and people leadership responsibilities
  • Pathway towards Mine Manager and senior operational leadership positions
About the Role
 
As the Senior Production Engineer, you'll be responsible for leading production engineering activities while supporting the safe and efficient delivery of underground mining operations.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and mentor Production Engineers and Graduate Engineers
  • Plan, supervise and optimise weekly drill and blast activities
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to maximise recovery and minimise dilution
  • Review and optimise firing strategies, ring designs and production practices
  • Support daily underground operations and achievement of production targets
  • Ensure compliance with engineering standards and operational plans
  • Assist with short and medium-term mine planning activities
  • Collaborate closely with operational and technical stakeholders
  • Support Mining Management with technical, operational and statutory requirements
About You To be successful, you'll bring:
  • Degree qualification in Mining Engineering
  • Underground hard rock mining experience
  • Strong drill & blast design and optimisation expertise
  • Experience in stope design, sequencing and production planning
  • Demonstrated leadership and people management capability
  • Proficiency with Deswik CAD, UGDB and Ventsim
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Current WA C Class Driver's Licence
  • First Class Mine Manager's Certificate or actively working towards obtaining one
 
Apply Now
 
If you're an experienced underground mining engineer with strong production, drill & blast and leadership capabilities, we'd love to hear from you.
 
This is an outstanding opportunity to join a successful operation, make a genuine impact on performance, and position yourself for future leadership advancement within the mining industry.

job.title: Environmental Officer - Greenfield Mining Project
job.description:
About the opportunity

Stellar Recruitment is partnering with an Australian mining company to recruit an Environmental Officer for a greenfield critical minerals project near Mudgee.

This is an opportunity to join during the development phase and help establish the environmental systems, plans and processes that will support the project as it progresses. You’ll work within an experienced environmental team, with exposure to senior management and scope to develop your expertise across a broad range of environmental disciplines.

The project is progressing through the approvals process, with groundworks targeted for 2028, subject to approvals. The proposed mining operation involves a single open pit and day-shift mining, with substantial company-owned landholdings in the surrounding area.

About the role

Reporting to the Environmental Superintendent, you’ll combine environmental management system development with monitoring, reporting and biodiversity-related activities. Rather than simply maintaining established systems, you’ll have the opportunity to help build them.

A key focus will be developing practical management plans, procedures, forms, registers and processes, alongside supporting biodiversity management across the company’s properties.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Contributing to the development and implementation of the environmental management system.
  • Supporting biodiversity assessments, monitoring programs and management of biodiversity properties.
  • Coordinating environmental inspections and monitoring across water, air quality, noise, heritage and biodiversity.
  • Interpreting environmental data, preparing reports and supporting regulatory compliance.
  • Working with internal teams, consultants and contractors to translate environmental obligations into practical actions.
About you

You’ll be an environmental professional who enjoys variety, works well independently and is comfortable building relationships across different teams. Experience in mining is welcome, but backgrounds in resources, construction, infrastructure or a regulatory environment will also be considered.

Ideally, you’ll bring a relevant qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Management or a related discipline, together with experience developing environmental management systems and interpreting environmental requirements. Strong written communication, organisation and stakeholder engagement skills will be important.

Experience managing biodiversity properties, coordinating biodiversity assessments or monitoring programs, and working with the NSW Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 will be particularly well regarded.

What’s on offer

An attractive remuneration package aligned with your experience, a supportive environmental team and the opportunity to broaden your expertise as the project develops.

You’ll work a 9-day fortnight, with accommodation available for the first six months to help you settle into the area. Set among rolling green hills and established rural communities, this opportunity would suit someone looking to build a career and a life in the Mudgee region.

Long-term residence in the area is required, although relocation does not need to happen immediately. There is flexibility to make the move over the first six to twelve months, allowing time to plan the transition.

How to apply

To express your interest, submit your resume through SEEK. For a confidential discussion about the role and relocation arrangements, contact the team at Stellar Recruitment.

job.title: Senior Mining Engineer - Short Term Planning
job.description:
• FIFO 8/6 Brisbane or Townsville OR Residential Mt Isa
  • Senior Mining Engineer - George Fisher Mine - large scale U/G lead / zinc
  • Attractive salary and benefits package
The operation:
  
George Fisher Mine (GFM) is a large-scale underground zinc-lead-silver operation based in Mt Isa, QLD. GFM has complex mining sequence, multiple operating fronts, and significant interactions among development, stoping, ventilation, backfill, infrastructure, services, and production readiness.
  
George Fisher has a long mine life and is a key strategic asset for Glencore globally.
  
The role:
  
The Senior Mining Engineer – Short Term Planning is responsible for leading and overseeing the preparation and delivery of short-term mine designs and plans to support the safe and efficient execution of development, production, services, and infrastructure activities
  
Your ability to translate medium- and long-term mine plans into practical short-term execution strategies aligned with operational capabilities and production targets will the crucial. We also need someone who can provide technical leadership and guidance to the mining engineering team and also optimise mine design / planning and drill and blast practices.
  
Experience required:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Mining Engineering or related subject
  • Minimum 6–8 years mining engineering experience, preferably within underground hard rock operations
  • Demonstrated experience in short-term mine planning, drill and blast design, and operational mine design.
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, graduates, or cadets.
  • Practical operational exposure with a strong understanding of underground mining methods and production processes.
  • Strong experience with mine design software such as Surpac, Vulcan, Datamine, or Deswik.
  • Advanced knowledge of drill and blast design, stope design, and operational mine planning.
Benefits on offer:
  • Permanent position working directly for Glencore.
  • Competitive salary package including 13% super, generous incentive scheme.
  • Access to training and professional development
  • Opportunity to work for a large mining company with opportunities to advance your career domestically and internationally.
  • Visa sponsorship available for suitability qualified candidates
  • FIFO to Mt Isa from Brisbane or Townsville or Mt Isa residential

Glencore has partnered with Stellar Recruitment to manage the recruitment and search for this position. Please contact Lucas Eyers to discuss further or apply direct via email / SEEK / LinkedIn

job.title: Human Resources Manager
job.description:
Harmony is the largest gold producer by volume in South Africa and is a significant operator of gold tailings retreatment facilities. CSA Mine has recently joined Harmony Australasia, marking the beginning of an exciting new chapter. The acquisition underpins Harmony’s strategy to expand its Australasian footprint and establish a strong, diversified copper portfolio, complemented by the Eva Copper Mine Project in Queensland, currently under construction, and set to become the state’s largest open‑pit copper mine upon commissioning. In Papua New Guinea, Harmony owns and operates the Hidden Valley mine and owns 50% of the Tier 1 Wafi-Golpu copper-gold project. These assets are supported by the Harmony Australasia regional corporate office located in Milton, Brisbane.
  
About The Role:

The Human Resources Manager – CSA Mine is responsible for delivering end‑to‑end HR leadership at the mine site. Working closely with and reporting to the site General Manager, this role supports safe and productive operations through effective workforce planning, industrial and employee relations, compliance with Australian employment legislation, and the development of a high‑performing workforce.
  
CSA Mine has a workforce of over 500 + contractors and there is also a site-based HR support team. The workforce consists of a mix of residential, DIDO and FIFO. 
  
Roster:
  
This role will be based onsite in Cobar, NSW working an 8/6-day FIFO roster from Brisbane or Sydney with local candidates highly regarded. Local candidates will be offered this opportunity on a 5/2 Monday to Friday roster.
  
Key Responsibilities:
  • Act as a trusted HR advisor to the Site General Manager and leadership team.
  • Deliver site‑based HR strategies aligned with operational and production objectives.
  • Translate corporate HR policies into practical site‑specific solutions.
  • Lead the onsite HR function, ensuring consistent and high‑quality service delivery.
  • Manage employee relations matters including performance management, grievances, investigations, and disciplinary processes.
  • Interpret and apply site enterprise agreements, awards, and contracts.
  • Support or lead enterprise agreement negotiations as required.
  • Liaise effectively with unions, employee representatives, and external advisors.
  • Lead the team that oversees end‑to‑end recruitment for site roles.
  • Manage onboarding, mobilisation, site inductions, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with site leaders on workforce planning, succession, and talent retention.
  • Support roster structures, FIFO/DIDO and residential arrangements, and fatigue management considerations.
  • Support psychosocial risk management and employee wellbeing initiatives.
  • Partner with HSE teams to ensure people‑related safety obligations are met.
  • Implement performance management and development frameworks.
  • Identify capability gaps and support training and development initiatives.
  • Drive engagement and retention strategies.
  • Support leadership development and workforce capability uplift.
  • Ensure compliance with the Fair Work Act, WHS legislation, and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate HR records, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Support audits, inspections, and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR systems and processes.
  • Promote a respectful, inclusive, and values‑driven site culture.
  • Support diversity and inclusion initiatives, including Indigenous engagement where applicable.
  • Act as a role model for company values and leadership behaviours.
About You:

To succeed in this role, you should be self-motivated and able to work efficiently and collaboratively in a team environment with the following skills, experience and personal attributes:
  • Tertiary qualification in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business, or related discipline.
  • Significant HR leadership experience within mining, resources, or heavy industry environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian employment law, industrial relations, and WHS requirements.
  • Proven experience supporting site workforces in remote operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior site leaders and manage complex employee relations.
  • Experience in unionised environments and enterprise bargaining.
  • Exposure to large‑scale workforce mobilisation.
  • Prior site‑based HR management experience.
  • Practical, resilient, and outcomes‑focused.
  • Strong communicator with credibility across operational teams.
  • High integrity, discretion, and sound judgement.
  • Collaborative, hands‑on leadership style.
What are the benefits of working for Harmony?
  • The opportunity to work for an international mining company with a diverse workforce.
  • Participation in the company bonus scheme.
  • Health and wellbeing initiatives, including access to gym and pool facilities to our employees and their dependants.
  • Join a business that is growing in Australia and exposed to the high growth commodities of copper and gold.
To learn more about Harmony and CSA Mine, please visit: https://www.harmony.co.za/operations/australia/csa-copper-mine/

For a confidential discussion on the position please reach out to Stellar Recruitment who are managing the process for this assignment.

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Design Manager with a strong interior design background to join a growing property and hospitality group based in Fortitude Valley.

This is not a traditional architecture-led Design Manager position. The business is looking for someone with creative flair, a strong eye for finishes, materials and spaces, and the ability to translate ideas into practical design outcomes across a diverse portfolio of hospitality, retail and accommodation assets.

Working closely with Project Managers and broader business stakeholders, you will help shape and maintain the design identity across the portfolio while also getting hands-on with smaller design projects.

The Role
As Design Manager, you will take ownership of design standards and provide creative design support across multiple business units and asset classes.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Create, refine and maintain design specifications and document libraries across the portfolio

  • Undertake design reviews and provide recommendations across projects
  • Deliver smaller in-house design projects such as accommodation room and amenities refreshes
  • Support Project Managers with QA and defect reviews
  • Assist with RFIs relating to finishes, materials and design intent
  • Provide design advice across capital expenditure projects
  • Contribute to value management reviews, including alternative finishes and product selections
  • Balance design outcomes with practical cost considerations

About You
The key to this position is your interior design capability and creative eye. You may already hold a Design Manager title, or you could be a strong Interior Designer ready to step into a broader position.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • Formal qualifications in Interior Design or a related discipline
  • Strong experience across interior design, preferably within hospitality, hotels, retail or commercial environments
  • A strong eye for finishes, materials, colour, furniture and overall design aesthetic

Importantly, the business is not looking for someone who is heavily architecture or technically focused. They are looking for someone who brings genuine artistic flair and interior design sensibility, while still understanding how their ideas translate into real-world projects.

About the Role
  
As SENIOR PROJECT ENGINEER you will work FIFO 2/1 ex-Perth, to support construction delivery of a large marine project for a blue-chip mining client on WA’s coast. This project will involve multidisciplinary elements of Civil, SMP and electrical works plus marine piling and steel erection being undertaken from a jack-up barge. Also you will lead and mentor younger engineers, and ensure adherence to financial, and contractual parameters.
